name: – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: Resolution on the deteriorating situation of women in Afghanistan due to the recent adoption of the law on the “Promotion of Virtue and Prevention of Vice”
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly criticises the Taliban's new "Promotion of Virtue and Prevention of Vice" law, which silences women's voices in public and adds to earlier bans on work, education and healthcare. The resolution is an opinion, not a law. It asks the Taliban to scrap these rules, release imprisoned women, reopen shelters for victims of violence, and let women take part in public life. It also asks the European Union to impose new sanctions and give more aid.

- What changes: nothing yet; Parliament asks the Taliban to end its bans on women.
- Who it affects: Afghan women and girls, and European Union aid and visa decisions.
- What happens next: European Union countries and the United Nations are urged to act.
